message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on facts. The case: group dismantled electrical transformers to steal copper wire bundles. This is theft of public property (electric power infrastructure) and theft of copper. Likely charges: theft (盗窃) of public property, maybe specifically "盗窃电力设施" or "盗窃公用设施". In Chinese criminal law, there is a specific offense: "盗窃电力设施、管道、通信设施等公用设施罪" (theft of public utilities). Also could be "破坏电力设施罪" (damage to power facilities). The facts include dismantling transformers (destruction) and stealing copper. The examples: For similar case of stealing cable, they gave "破坏广播电视设施、公用电信设施;盗窃". So they used two charges: one for damaging facilities (破坏...设施) and one for theft (盗窃). For copper theft from transformers, likely "破坏电力设施罪" and "盗窃". Also maybe "非法买卖废旧金属" but not indicated. The sale to another person is part of theft proceeds, but main crimes are theft and damage.

Thus answer: [罪名]破坏电力设施;盗窃<eoa>
